title: Joseph Reveals Himself

questions.question: What did Joseph reveal to his brothers?
options: That he was their brother Joseph
questions.correctAnswer: That he was their brother Joseph
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:3 (ESV): "Joseph said to his brothers, 'I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?'"

questions.question: How did the brothers react to Joseph's revelation?
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:3: "His brothers could not answer him, for they were dismayed at his presence."

questions.question: Where did Joseph tell his family to come live?
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:10: "You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near me."

questions.question: Did Pharaoh approve of Joseph's family coming to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:16-20: Pharaoh was pleased and offered them the best of the land of Egypt.

questions.question: How did Joseph and Benjamin greet each other?
options: They wept on each other's necks
questions.correctAnswer: They wept on each other's necks
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:14: "Then he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck and wept, and Benjamin wept upon his neck."

questions.question: What did Joseph say about why God sent him to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:5: "God sent me before you to preserve life."

questions.question: How many more years of famine did Joseph say remained?
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:6: "For the famine has been in the land these two years, and there are yet five years."

questions.question: What did Joseph send to Jacob?
options: Carts, provisions, and changes of clothing
questions.correctAnswer: Carts, provisions, and changes of clothing
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:21-23: Joseph gave them carts, provisions, changes of clothes, and extra gifts for Benjamin.

questions.question: How much silver did Joseph give Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:22: "To Benjamin he gave 300 shekels of silver and five changes of garments."

questions.question: What was Jacob's initial reaction to the news?
options: His heart became numb, for he did not believe them
questions.correctAnswer: His heart became numb, for he did not believe them
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:26: "His heart became numb, for he did not believe them."

questions.question: What convinced Jacob that Joseph was alive?
options: When he saw the carts Joseph had sent
questions.correctAnswer: When he saw the carts Joseph had sent
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:27: "But when he saw the carts that Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of their father Jacob revived."

questions.question: What did Joseph say about who sent him to Egypt?
options: It was not his brothers but God who sent him
questions.correctAnswer: It was not his brothers but God who sent him
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:8: "So it was not you who sent me here, but God."

questions.question: What role did Joseph say God gave him in Egypt?
options: A father to Pharaoh and lord of all his house
questions.correctAnswer: A father to Pharaoh and lord of all his house
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:8: "He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house and ruler over all the land of Egypt."

questions.question: What parting instruction did Joseph give his brothers?
options: Do not quarrel on the way
questions.correctAnswer: Do not quarrel on the way
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:24: "Then he sent his brothers away, and as they departed, he said to them, 'Do not quarrel on the way.'"

questions.question: What did Joseph say God made him in addition to lord of Pharaoh's house?
options: Ruler over all the land of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Ruler over all the land of Egypt
questions.explanation: Genesis 45:8-9: Joseph described himself as ruler over all the land of Egypt.

key_verse_text: God sent me before you to preserve life.
